summary: Adds a global predicate `Meromorphic` (meromorphic at every point) as a shorthand for `MeromorphicOn` on `Set.univ`, together with a basic `fun_prop` closure API (neg/add/sub/mul/div/pow/zpow/deriv and finite sums/products) mirroring the existing `MeromorphicOn`/`MeromorphicAt` lemmas.

summary: Adds a small API showing that for continuous maps into order-topological types (with closed lower/upper sets), taking upper/lower bounds—and hence (co)supr/(co)infr in conditionally complete (linear) orders—can be computed on any dense subset of the domain.
